basic.name: Celestial Charge
basic.description: Lunge towards a targeted direction and stab, dealing 35~~0.04~~ damage. If an enemy Hero is hit, Channel to Stun for 1 second and deal 80~~0.04~~ additional damage when it fully finishes.

basic.name: Solarion's Fire
basic.description: Release a fiery wave that deals 110~~0.04~~ damage. Enemies hit by the center take 50% bonus damage and are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Molten Armor
basic.description: Shroud Imperius in flames for 3 seconds, striking a nearby enemy for 19~~0.04~~ damage every 0.25 seconds. Imperius heals for 50% of the damage dealt, increased to 100% against Heroes. Strikes 2 additional targets if no Heroes are in range, and restores 1 Mana for each strike on expiration.

heroic.name: Angelic Armaments
heroic.description:
Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850~~0.04~~ Shield for 3 seconds.

If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit.

heroic.name: Wrath of the Angiris
heroic.description:
After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.

After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

trait.name: Valorous Brand
trait.description: Each Basic Ability marks enemy Heroes hit for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks consume the target's marks, dealing 20% bonus damage per mark and healing for 75~~0.04~~ per mark.

activable.name: Holy Fervor
activable.description: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

activable.name: Valorous Pursuit
activable.description: Activate to teleport to an enemy that has been marked by Valorous Brand and gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

activable.name: Impervious
activable.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with the center of Solarion's Fire reduces this cooldown by 5 seconds.

level1.name: Impaling Light
level1.description:
Celestial Charge deals 150% more damage to Heroes, reduced by 25% for each additional Hero hit. For each Valorous Brand on the target when Celestial Charge's Stun completes, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

Passive: Reduce Celestial Charge's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and its Mana cost from 40 to 30.

level1.name: Consuming Flame
level1.description: Increase the center damage of Solarion's Fire by an additional 125% and its Slow amount by 15%. The first enemy Hero hit with Solarion's Fire restores 30 Mana.

level1.name: Burn the Impure
level1.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level4.name: Sovereign Armor
level4.description: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Molten Armor extends the duration of this Armor by 0.5 seconds.

level4.name: Battle Hunger
level4.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level4.name: Press Forward
level4.description: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe. Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

level7.name: Flash of Anger
level7.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150~~0.04~~ damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250~~0.04~~ point Shield for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Blaze of Glory
level7.description: Solarion's Fire leaves a line of scorched earth along its center that explodes after 1.75 seconds for 212~~0.04~~ damage, dealing bonus damage with Valorous Brand marks.

level7.name: Holy Fervor
level7.description: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

level10.name: Angelic Armaments
level10.description:
Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850~~0.04~~ Shield for 3 seconds.

If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit.

level10.description:

After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

level13.name: Pathetic Mortals
level13.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

level13.name: Divine Rage
level13.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

level13.name: Heat of Battle
level13.description: Increase Molten Armor's healing against Heroes by 2% for every 1% Health Imperius is missing.

level16.name: Celestial Swiftness
level16.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

level16.name: Melting Touch
level16.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

level16.name: Valorous Pursuit
level16.description: Activate to teleport to an enemy that has been marked by Valorous Brand and gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Heavenly Host
level20.description:
Shields granted by Angelic Armaments no longer expire, and on initial activation, nearby allied Heroes gain a Shield that absorbs 600~~0.04~~ damage.

If a Shield granted to an allied Hero lasts 3 seconds, it fires 1 sword at a nearby enemy, prioritizing closest Heroes, dealing 140~~0.04~~ damage.

level20.name: Unrelenting Descent
level20.description: Descending from the Heavens restores 30% of Imperius' maximum Health and Mana. Consuming a Valorous Brand reduces the cooldown of Wrath of the Angiris by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Molten Wrath
level20.description: Molten Armor's radius is increased by 25%, and it always strikes 2 additional targets, even if there are Heroes in range.

level20.name: Brand of Solarion
level20.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

level20.name: Impervious
level20.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with the center of Solarion's Fire reduces this cooldown by 5 seconds.
